ra.name: rheumatoid arthritis
info: Joint pain, swelling and morning stiffness, symmetric in the small joints of hands and feet: caused by chronic inflammation of the synovial membrane that lines the joints
Progressive joint deformity and loss of function: invasive growth of the synovial lining cells and excessive bone resorption by bone-degrading cells erode cartilage and bone
The inflammation is sustained by the adaptive immune system: self-reactive T cells, antibody-producing B cells and infiltrating macrophages accumulate in the synovium
Fatigue, low-grade fever and anaemia: systemic effects of inflammatory mediators released by the activated immune cells
Accelerated cardiovascular disease and interstitial lung disease: consequences of long-standing systemic inflammation

scz.name: schizophrenia
info: Hallucinations, delusions and disorganised thought (positive symptoms): linked to excessive neurotransmission in striatal circuits of the basal ganglia
Loss of motivation, blunted emotion and social withdrawal (negative symptoms): related to reduced activity of prefrontal cortical circuits
Deficits in working memory, attention and executive function: impaired excitatory synaptic signalling and inhibitory interneuron dysfunction in prefrontal cortex and hippocampus
Onset in late adolescence: coincides with excessive elimination of synapses and disturbed development of cortical circuits
Chronic relapsing course: persistent dysregulation of cortico-striato-thalamic loops

cystinuria.name: cystinuria
info: Recurrent kidney stones from childhood, with flank pain, haematuria and urinary obstruction: a poorly soluble dibasic amino acid crystallises in the urine
Excessive urinary loss of that amino acid and of other dibasic amino acids: failed reabsorption across the apical membrane of proximal tubule epithelial cells
Autosomal recessive inheritance: loss of function of the transport complex that reabsorbs these amino acids in the kidney and small intestine
Chronic kidney damage and infections: repeated obstruction and stone surgery
Symptoms improve with high fluid intake and urinary alkalinisation, which increase the solubility of the amino acid

prostate_cancer.name: prostate cancer
info: Urinary obstruction and a rising blood biomarker: uncontrolled proliferation of luminal epithelial cells of the prostate gland
Tumour growth depends on male sex hormone signalling in the epithelial cells; suppression of that signalling shrinks tumours, but resistance emerges within years
Bone pain and fractures: metastases to bone that stimulate bone-forming and bone-resorbing cells
Progression under hormone suppression: reactivation of the hormone-driven transcriptional programme, loss of tumour-suppressor genes and defective DNA repair
A minority of advanced tumours lose the epithelial programme and acquire a neuroendocrine, treatment-resistant phenotype

achondroplasia.name: achondroplasia
info: Disproportionate short stature with short proximal limbs: reduced proliferation and premature maturation of chondrocytes in the growth plates of long bones
The growth-plate defect is caused by a constitutively over-active growth-inhibitory receptor signalling in chondrocytes (autosomal dominant gain of function)

Narrowing of the opening at the base of the skull and of the spinal canal: impaired growth of cartilage-derived bone at the skull base and vertebrae, causing compression of the brainstem and spinal cord
Large head with prominent forehead and midface hypoplasia: reduced endochondral growth of the skull base
Sleep apnoea, recurrent ear infections and bowed legs: consequences of the altered craniofacial and limb skeleton
